title: WPSS/421/2012 of SURESH CHANDRA ARYA Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND and OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No. 421 of 2012
Hon'ble Tarun Agarwala, J.
Mr. Rajendra Dobhal, Senior Advocate
assisted by Mr. G.D. Joshi, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. H.M. Raturi, Standing Counsel for the
State.
By the impugned order, the petitioner has
been transferred. It is alleged that the transfer
order is stigmatic and further the petitioner is on
the verge of the retirement since his
superannuation is eleven months away and,
consequently, on both these grounds, the
impugned order should not have been passed. In
the opinion of the Court, the petitioner has been
transferred on administrative grounds and the
impugned order is not stigmatic. However, if
the petitioner is aggrieved by the transfer order,
he may make an appropriate representation to
the authority concerned. If such a representation
is filed, the authority concerned will decide the
matter by a reasoned and speaking order within
two weeks from the date of the production of a
certified copy of the order.
The writ petition is disposed of.
 (Tarun Agarwala, J.)
Dated 03.04.2012
Shiv
